couture.name: Aurelia — sculpted velvet and organza gown

notes: Position-based dynamics, CPU, deterministic (no randomness in the solve).
The garment collides with the mannequin surface and the floor; it does not self-collide in this build.
Strain is measured on the structural edges; the max-strain limit is applied as a soft target, not a hard cap.

layers.note: Simulated 70 steps × 10 iterations (0.146s of motion), settled to 0.355 mm; hem fold amplitude now 168% of the cut amplitude.

sculptural.note: An offset double-sided shell: volume that reads as light rather than cloth.
Curved structural ribs held off the body — the corsetry/armature layer.
A flared band around the neck: the couture collar that frames the face.
Discrete curved panels with gaps — a modular silhouette.

Pleat retention is the hem's radial fold amplitude after the solve divided by its amplitude as cut.
No external generation API is involved: geometry, simulation and checks are computed locally.
